Demo University of Health Sciences
Fee Circular No. 03/2025

Reference: University Notification No. 1123 dated 2025-04-02.

The following fee structure is prescribed for the B.Sc. MLT
programme with effect from the academic year 2025-26.

Tuition fee: Rs. 95000 per annum
Laboratory fee: Rs. 15000 per annum
Registration fee: Rs. 2000 per annum

The fee shall be paid online before the commencement of classes.
